args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. None flagged; all 8 cleared (r01 to r08).
All three checks passed on every run: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. No run kept a remedy or rolled back. The width-free ratio was not used.
r01 and r08 show |z| = 3.19 on REGR peak, growth-zone length and flank difference. This only reflects a batch MAD of zero. The real differences are small: REGR peak +0.01 %/h, growth zone -11 µm (about 1.6 %) and flank difference +0.09 %/h. The peak and flank positions are the same (421 µm), so the strain-rate profile has the same shape as the rest of the batch.
Nothing is shared by flagged runs, because no runs were flagged. The velocity, strain-rate and curvature-rate results in this batch can be reported.
